probe.title: Click Therapeutics - Where Science Meets Software
probe.text_sample: Click Therapeutics - Where Science Meets Software Platform Products Click SE Insights About Collaborate with us What’s new? Where science meets software. Software as treatment. Delivered to your phone. Prescribed by your physician. Click Therapeutics is redefining modern medicine with patient-centric digital treatments. Operating at the intersection of biology and technology, Click combines neuroscience with the power of software, creating a new way to treat disease. Read more about us Digital treatments, tangible outcomes. We develop, validate, and commercialize software as prescription medical treatments for people with unmet medical needs. Learn more about products on our platform Click SE Medicine just got a digital upgrade: Software-Enhanced Drugs™ Click SE™ solutions combine software with pharmacotherapy to create software-enhanced drug™ treatments, designed to deliver added clinical benefit to patients compared to drug alone. Discover Click SE™ One powerful platform. Many ways to treat disease. Our multimodal, platform-based approach targets disease and drives outcomes from multiple different angles, combining scientifically proven therapies with proprietary neuromodulatory

vibe.evidence: The use of geometric patterns in the background, clean typography, and a light color palette suggest a futuristic and geometric style. The overall layout is clean and organized, contributing to a calm and confident mood. The navigation is minimal, and the CTA voice is a soft invite. The color palette is predominantly cool and pastel, with a light tone. The whitespace is balanced, and the typography is sans-serif led. The grid is asymmetric, and the motion is static. The layout rhythm is alternating splits. The ornament density is subtle, with gradient mesh and lines as ornaments. The imagery includes typography-only and some photographic elements.
